final: WITH invoice_metrics AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) as avg_qty, (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) / SUM(derived_total_cost) as rel_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_qty) as overall_avg FROM invoice_metrics) SELECT im.invoice_number, im.avg_qty, im.rel_gap, im.avg_qty - oa.overall_avg as qty_diff FROM invoice_metrics im CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE im.avg_qty > oa.overall_avg ORDER BY qty_diff DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
